name: De Leon Furniture, Inc.
old_description: De Leon Furniture has been family-owned and operated since 1967. We’ve treated every customer like they were a part of our family. Other companies may offer similar services, but our services come with a personal touch.
about:
De Leon Furniture, Inc. was founded in 1967 in Kansas City, Kansas, as a family-owned and operated business. The deLeon family has been building furniture for over four generations, with the last 45 years spent in the United States.

The company provides upholstery, refinishing, and restoration services, and custom builds high-end period furniture as well as unique modern pieces. Its workshop handles woodworking and furniture finishing, including the application of oils and waxes for sprayless finishes. De Leon also sells DIY products such as furniture oils, waxes, and felt glides for floor protection.

Services are delivered primarily through architects and interior designers, who specify the firm for residential and commercial projects. The DIY product line serves individual consumers looking for maintenance supplies.

De Leon emphasizes a personal touch in customer relations, rooted in its family ownership. The company states that its quality control standards are high and that its craftsmen are among the best in the business, a reputation built over decades of furniture making.
